in_hebrew.name: Bili
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו God is my strength
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Bili הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'bios' meaning 'life' and 'helos' meaning 'strength'. The name Bili carries the powerful meaning of 'God is my strength'. This name is a reminder that no matter what challenges come our way, God is always with us, providing the strength we need to overcome.
